newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan names advisers for Sui Northern.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan names advisers for Sui Northern.

text.p: Pakistan's Privatisation Commission has named N.M. Rothschild and First Capital Securities as financial advisers on the privatisation of Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Ltd (SNGPL), a statement said.
The government statement, received on Monday, said the new agreement continued an earlier one with First Capital Securities under which Sui Northern was to have been privatised in 1995.

The process had been held up by delays in setting up regulatory and tariff frameworks, but the government now envisaged Sui Northern's privatisation to be completed by the end of fiscal 1996/97 (July-June), the statement said.
It said several potential investors had shown interest in the privatisation of Pakistan's gas transmission and distribution network.
